details: :sp stacks a view above/below
Ctrl-w s does the same from Normal
:sp Foo.kt opens Foo.kt below
:vs opens a side-by-side view
Ctrl-w v does the same from Normal
:vs Foo.kt opens Foo.kt beside it
Closes this split and its tabs
Files open elsewhere stay open
Ctrl-w q does the same
Other splits close with their tabs
Ctrl-w o does the same from Normal

tips.summary: Cycle through splits Ctrl-w w / W
details: Ctrl-w w goes to the next split
Ctrl-w W goes to the previous split

tips.summary: Move to a split Ctrl-w h/j/k/l
details: Ctrl-w l jumps to the right split
h left, j down, k up work the same

tips.summary: Make a split taller or shorter
details: Ctrl-w + grows, Ctrl-w - shrinks
10 Ctrl-w + adds ten rows at once

tips.summary: Make a split wider or narrower
details: Ctrl-w > widens, Ctrl-w < narrows
10 Ctrl-w > adds ten columns
Every split gets the same size
Undoes drags and Ctrl-w + tweaks
gt goes to the next tab
gT goes to the previous tab

tips.summary: Jump to a tab by number 3gt
details: Tabs count from 1, left to right
Counts only this split's tabs
Closes the other tabs in this split
Same as the IDE's Close Other Tabs
:tabmove 0 moves it to the start
Bare :tabmove moves it to the end

tips.summary: Maximize a split's height or width
details: Ctrl-w _ maxes this split's height
Ctrl-w | maxes its width
